说明: 浑天图谱导出给 Github学习 出题用的地基清单。planet 为细分领域（分区），major 为合并后的行星；suggested_level 由轨道层级决定（一、二轨 F 基础，三、四轨 X 拓展）；prereq 只列清单内的前置地基；route_order 为航线推荐顺序。

items.name: fastapi
items.summary: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
items.what_zh: 用 Python 写 Web 接口的框架，依据类型标注自动校验参数、生成可交互的接口文档，支持异步。
items.what_en: A Python framework for building web APIs: it validates parameters from type hints, generates interactive API docs, and supports async.

items.name: langchain
items.summary: Building applications with LLMs through composability
items.what_zh: 搭建大模型应用的 Python 框架，把模型调用、提示词、检索和工具调用拼装成流程。
items.what_en: A Python framework for building LLM apps by composing model calls, prompts, retrieval and tool calling into pipelines.

items.name: openai
items.summary: The official Python library for the openai API
items.what_zh: 官方 Python SDK，几行代码调用 OpenAI 的模型接口，支持流式输出和工具调用；许多兼容服务也用它接入。
items.what_en: The official Python SDK for OpenAI's API: call its models in a few lines, with streaming and tool calling. Many compatible services also accept it.

items.name: react-markdown
items.summary: React component to render markdown
items.what_zh: 在 React 页面里把 Markdown 文本显示成格式化内容的组件，可通过插件扩展语法。
items.what_en: A React component that displays Markdown text as formatted content on a page, extensible through plugins.

items.name: chromadb
items.summary: Chroma.
items.what_zh: 开源向量数据库，存储文本的嵌入，再按语义相似度做向量检索，常用于 RAG。
items.what_en: An open-source vector database that stores text embeddings and finds semantically similar items via vector search; common in RAG.

items.name: sentence-transformers
items.summary: Embeddings, Retrieval, and Reranking
items.what_zh: 把句子或段落转成向量（嵌入）的 Python 库，可用于语义搜索、相似度比较和结果重排序。
items.what_en: A Python library that turns sentences or paragraphs into vectors (embeddings) for semantic search, similarity comparison and reranking results.

items.name: pypdf
items.summary: A pure-python PDF library capable of splitting, merging, cropping, and transforming PDF files
items.what_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 PDF 库，能拆分、合并、裁剪、旋转页面，也能提取文字。
items.what_en: A pure-Python PDF library for splitting, merging, cropping and rotating pages, plus extracting text.

items.name: mcp
items.summary: Model Context Protocol SDK
items.what_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）的官方 Python SDK：按统一标准把工具和数据开放给大模型应用，或在应用中调用它们。
items.what_en: The official Python SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP): expose tools and data to LLM apps through one standard, or call them from an app.

items.name: gradio
items.summary: Python library for easily interacting with trained machine learning models
items.what_zh: 用几行 Python 给机器学习模型做网页界面，可上传图片、输入文字并查看结果，方便分享演示。
items.what_en: Build a web interface for a machine learning model in a few lines of Python: upload images, type text, see results, and share it easily.

items.name: pymupdf
items.summary: A high performance Python library for data extraction, analysis, conversion & manipulation of PDF (and other) documents.
items.what_zh: 基于 MuPDF 的 Python 库，能快速提取 PDF 等文档中的文字、图片和表格，也能编辑、转换、渲染页面。
items.what_en: A Python library built on MuPDF that quickly extracts text, images and tables from PDFs and other documents, and can edit, convert and render pages.

items.name: peft
items.summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)
items.what_zh: Hugging Face 的参数高效微调库（如 LoRA），只训练少量新增参数，就能让大模型适应新任务。
items.what_en: Hugging Face's parameter-efficient fine-tuning library, such as LoRA: train a small set of added parameters to adapt an LLM to new tasks.

items.name: vllm
items.summary: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
items.what_zh: 高吞吐、省显存的大模型推理与服务引擎，一条命令即可起一个兼容 OpenAI 接口的模型服务。
items.what_en: A high-throughput, memory-efficient engine for LLM inference and serving; one command starts an OpenAI-compatible model server.

items.name: dompurify
items.summary: DOMPurify is a DOM-only, super-fast, uber-tolerant XSS sanitizer for HTML, MathML and SVG. It runs as JavaScript and works in all modern browsers, as well as in Node.js (via jsdom). DOMPurify is written by security people who have vast background in web a
items.what_zh: 清除 HTML、SVG 等内容中恶意脚本的工具，用来防范 XSS（跨站脚本）攻击。
items.what_en: Strips malicious scripts from HTML, SVG and MathML content to prevent XSS (cross-site scripting) attacks.

items.name: pydantic
items.summary: Data validation using Python type hints
items.what_zh: 用 Python 类型标注声明数据结构，自动校验和转换传入的数据，不合规时给出清晰报错。
items.what_en: Declare data structures with Python type hints; it validates and converts incoming data automatically and reports clear errors when it doesn't fit.

items.name: opentelemetry-sdk
items.summary: OpenTelemetry Python SDK
items.what_zh: 按 OpenTelemetry 开放标准采集调用链路、指标和日志的 Python 实现，可导出到各类监控平台。
items.what_en: The Python implementation of the OpenTelemetry standard, collecting traces, metrics and logs and exporting them to monitoring backends.

items.name: sentencepiece
items.summary: Unsupervised text tokenizer and detokenizer.
items.what_zh: Google 开源的分词器，直接从原始文本学习词表，不依赖空格切词，适合中文、日文等语言。
items.what_en: Google's open-source tokenizer that learns a vocabulary directly from raw text without relying on spaces, which suits languages like Chinese and Japanese.

items.name: numpy
items.summary: Fundamental package for array computing in Python
items.what_zh: Python 处理多维数组（向量、矩阵）的基础库，整批数字一次算完，底层用 C 实现，比逐个循环快得多。
items.what_en: The core Python library for multi-dimensional arrays (vectors, matrices). It runs math on whole arrays at once in C, far faster than Python loops.

items.name: torch
items.summary: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
items.what_zh: 最常用的深度学习框架之一：用张量（可在 GPU 上运算的多维数组）搭建、训练和运行神经网络。
items.what_en: A widely used deep learning framework: build, train and run neural networks with tensors, multi-dimensional arrays that can compute on GPUs.

items.name: transformers
items.summary: Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
items.what_zh: 统一加载和使用预训练模型（别人已训练好的模型）的框架，覆盖文本、图像、语音，可推理也可训练。
items.what_en: A framework giving one interface to load, run and train pretrained models (models already trained by others) for text, vision, audio and multimodal tasks.

items.name: torchvision
items.summary: image and video datasets and models for torch deep learning
items.what_zh: PyTorch 的计算机视觉配套库，提供常用图像数据集、预训练模型和图像变换工具。
items.what_en: PyTorch's computer vision companion: common image datasets, pretrained models and image transformation tools.

items.name: onnxruntime
items.summary: ONNX Runtime is a runtime accelerator for Machine Learning models
items.what_zh: 运行 ONNX 格式机器学习模型的推理引擎，可在 CPU、GPU 等多种硬件上加速推理。
items.what_en: An inference engine that runs machine learning models in the ONNX format, accelerating inference on CPUs, GPUs and other hardware.

items.name: httpx
items.summary: The next generation HTTP client.
items.what_zh: 新一代 Python HTTP 客户端，用法接近 requests，同时支持同步和异步写法，并支持 HTTP/2。
items.what_en: A modern Python HTTP client with a requests-like API that supports both synchronous and async code, plus HTTP/2.

items.name: langfuse
items.summary: Langfuse Python SDK - LLM observability/tracing, datasets, experiments, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and prompt management
items.what_zh: 开源大模型可观测平台 Langfuse 的 Python SDK：记录每次调用链路，支持评测、数据集和提示词管理。
items.what_en: Python SDK for Langfuse, an open-source LLM observability platform that traces every call and supports evaluation, datasets and prompt management.

items.name: opentelemetry-api
items.summary: OpenTelemetry Python API
items.what_zh: 可观测性开放标准 OpenTelemetry 的 Python 接口：在代码里记录调用链路、指标等数据，供监控系统分析。
items.what_en: The Python API of the OpenTelemetry observability standard: record traces, metrics and similar data in code for monitoring systems to analyse.

items.name: litellm
items.summary: Library to easily interface with LLM API providers
items.what_zh: 用同一套 OpenAI 风格接口调用多家大模型 API 的 Python 库，也能部署成统一网关。
items.what_en: A Python library for calling many LLM providers' APIs through one OpenAI-style interface; it can also run as a unified gateway.

items.name: redis
items.summary: Python client for Redis database and key-value store
items.what_zh: Redis 内存数据库的官方 Python 客户端，常用于缓存、消息队列和会话存储。
items.what_en: The official Python client for Redis, the in-memory database, commonly used for caching, queues and session storage.

items.name: tiktoken
items.summary: tiktoken is a fast BPE tokeniser for use with OpenAI's models
items.what_zh: OpenAI 开源的快速分词器，把文本切成模型实际处理的 token（词片段），常用来统计 token 数、估算费用。
items.what_en: OpenAI's open-source tokenizer: splits text into the tokens (word pieces) its models process, often used to count tokens and estimate cost.

items.name: jsonschema
items.summary: An implementation of JSON Schema validation for Python
items.what_zh: 按 JSON Schema 标准校验数据的 Python 库，该标准用来描述 JSON 应有哪些字段、各是什么类型。
items.what_en: Validates data against JSON Schema in Python. JSON Schema is a standard way to describe which fields and types a JSON document should have.

items.name: pandas
items.summary: Powerful data structures for data analysis, time series, and statistics
items.what_zh: Python 处理表格数据的核心库，像在代码里用 Excel：筛选、分组汇总、合并表格和处理时间序列。
items.what_en: Python's core library for tabular data, like Excel in code: filter, group and summarise, merge tables and handle time series.

items.name: datasets
items.summary: HuggingFace community-driven open-source library of datasets
items.what_zh: 一行代码加载 Hugging Face 上的公开数据集或本地文件，大数据集也不必全部读入内存。
items.what_en: Load public datasets from Hugging Face or local files in one line; large datasets don't have to fit in memory.

items.name: prometheus-client
items.summary: Python client for the Prometheus monitoring system.
items.what_zh: 让 Python 程序暴露请求数、延迟等运行指标，供 Prometheus 监控系统定时采集。
items.what_en: Lets Python programs expose runtime metrics like request counts and latency for the Prometheus monitoring system to collect.

items.name: bitsandbytes
items.summary: k-bit optimizers and matrix multiplication routines.
items.what_zh: 提供低比特（如 8 位、4 位）量化和优化器的库，让大模型训练和运行时占用更少显存。
items.what_en: A library of low-bit (such as 8-bit and 4-bit) quantization and optimizers that lets LLMs train and run with less GPU memory.

items.name: wandb
items.summary: A CLI and library for interacting with the Weights & Biases API.
items.what_zh: Weights & Biases 平台的命令行和 Python 库，用来记录、对比和可视化机器学习实验。
items.what_en: The command-line tool and Python library for Weights & Biases, a platform for logging, comparing and visualizing machine learning experiments.

items.name: typing-extensions
items.summary: Backported and Experimental Type Hints for Python 3.9+
items.what_zh: 让旧版 Python 也能用上新版才有的类型标注写法（标明变量应是什么类型），并提供试验中的新特性。
items.what_en: Lets older Python versions use type-hint features (labels saying what type a variable should be) from newer versions, plus experimental ones.

items.name: react
items.summary: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
items.what_zh: 构建网页界面的 JavaScript 库：把页面拆成可复用的组件，数据变化时自动更新界面。
items.what_en: A JavaScript library for building web interfaces: split pages into reusable components that update automatically when data changes.

items.name: packaging
items.summary: Core utilities for Python packages
items.what_zh: Python 打包工具共用的小工具集，用来解析和比较版本号（如 2.10 是否新于 2.9）及依赖要求。
items.what_en: Shared helpers used by Python packaging tools to parse and compare version numbers (is 2.10 newer than 2.9?) and dependency requirements.

items.name: requests
items.summary: Python HTTP for Humans.
items.what_zh: 用一行代码发 HTTP 请求的 Python 库，自动处理编码、重定向和 Cookie。
items.what_en: A Python library for sending HTTP requests in one line, handling encodings, redirects and cookies for you.

items.name: PyYAML
items.summary: YAML parser and emitter for Python
items.what_zh: 在 Python 中读写 YAML 的库。YAML 是一种靠缩进表示层级、常用于配置文件的文本格式。
items.what_en: Reads and writes YAML in Python. YAML is a human-friendly text format that uses indentation for structure, common in config files.

items.name: zod
items.summary: TypeScript-first schema declaration and validation library with static type inference
items.what_zh: TypeScript 的数据校验库：写一次数据结构定义，既能在运行时校验数据，又能自动得到类型。
items.what_en: A TypeScript validation library: define a data shape once and get both runtime validation and static types inferred from it.

items.name: tqdm
items.summary: Fast, Extensible Progress Meter
items.what_zh: 给循环加上进度条，显示已完成比例、处理速度和预计剩余时间。
items.what_en: Adds a progress bar to loops, showing percent complete, speed and estimated time remaining.

items.name: huggingface-hub
items.summary: Client library to download and publish models, datasets and other repos on the huggingface.co hub
items.what_zh: 连接 Hugging Face（开源模型分享平台）的客户端，用代码下载、上传模型和数据集等文件。
items.what_en: The client for Hugging Face, a platform for sharing open models: download and upload models, datasets and other repo files from code.

items.name: idna
items.summary: Internationalized Domain Names in Applications (IDNA)

items.name: anyio
items.summary: High-level concurrency and networking framework on top of asyncio or Trio
items.what_zh: 异步编程的统一接口，同一套代码可跑在 asyncio 或 Trio 上；异步指等网络时不卡住其他任务。
items.what_en: A unified async toolkit whose code runs on either asyncio or Trio. Async means other tasks keep running while one waits on the network.

items.name: click
items.summary: Composable command line interface toolkit
items.what_zh: 在函数上加几行标注就能做成命令行工具，自动处理参数、帮助信息和子命令。
items.what_en: Turns Python functions into command-line tools with a few annotations; it handles arguments, help text and subcommands.

items.name: certifi
items.summary: Python package for providing Mozilla's CA Bundle.
items.what_zh: 提供 Mozilla 维护的可信证书机构清单，供 Python 程序在 HTTPS 连接时核验网站身份。
items.what_en: Ships Mozilla's list of trusted certificate authorities so Python programs can verify a website's identity over HTTPS.

items.name: pillow
items.summary: Python Imaging Library (fork)
items.what_zh: Python 最常用的图片处理库，可打开、裁剪、缩放、转换格式并保存多种格式的图片。
items.what_en: Python's most widely used image library: open, crop, resize, convert and save images in many formats.

items.name: react-dom
items.summary: React package for working with the DOM.
items.what_zh: 把 React 组件真正渲染到浏览器页面上，负责把界面变化同步到网页元素（DOM）。
items.what_en: Renders React components into the browser page, syncing interface changes to the page's elements (the DOM).

items.name: regex
items.summary: Alternative regular expression module, to replace re.
items.what_zh: 可替代标准库 re 的正则表达式（描述文本模式的规则）库，功能更多，对 Unicode 多语言文字支持更好。
items.what_en: A drop-in alternative to Python's re module for regular expressions (text-matching patterns), with more features and better Unicode support.

items.name: safetensors
items.what_zh: 安全保存模型权重的文件格式：加载时不会执行隐藏代码，比 pickle 格式安全，读取也快。
items.what_en: A file format for storing model weights safely: loading never runs hidden code, unlike pickle-based files, and it loads quickly.

items.name: urllib3
items.summary: HTTP library with thread-safe connection pooling, file post, and more.
items.what_zh: 较底层的 Python HTTP 客户端，负责连接复用（连接池）、重试和文件上传，requests 就建在它之上。
items.what_en: A lower-level Python HTTP client handling connection reuse (pooling), retries and file uploads; requests is built on it.

items.name: MarkupSafe
items.summary: Safely add untrusted strings to HTML/XML markup.
items.what_zh: 把不可信文本安全地放进 HTML，自动转义 < > 等特殊字符，防止被注入恶意脚本。
items.what_en: Safely inserts untrusted text into HTML/XML by escaping special characters like < and >, preventing script-injection attacks.

items.name: typing-inspection
items.summary: Runtime typing introspection tools
items.what_zh: 在运行时分析类型标注的工具，如判断标注是否为 Literal 或 Annotated，供 Pydantic 等库使用。
items.what_en: Tools for examining type annotations while a program runs, such as checking whether one is Literal or Annotated; used by libraries like Pydantic.

items.name: python-dateutil
items.summary: Extensions to the standard Python datetime module
items.what_zh: 扩展 Python 自带的日期时间功能：解析各种写法的日期字符串、计算相对日期、处理时区。
items.what_en: Extends Python's built-in datetime: parse dates written in many formats, compute relative dates like 'next month', and handle time zones.

items.name: rich
items.summary: Render rich text, tables, progress bars, syntax highlighting, markdown and more to the terminal
items.what_zh: 让终端输出更易读：彩色文字、表格、进度条、代码高亮和 Markdown 渲染。
items.what_en: Makes terminal output easier to read: colored text, tables, progress bars, syntax highlighting and Markdown rendering.

items.name: psutil
items.summary: Cross-platform lib for process and system monitoring.
items.what_zh: 跨平台读取 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络和进程等系统运行信息的库。
items.what_en: A cross-platform library for reading system information: CPU, memory, disk, network usage and running processes.

items.name: Jinja2
items.summary: A very fast and expressive template engine.
items.what_zh: 模板引擎：在文本里留出占位符和简单逻辑，运行时填入数据，生成网页、配置或提示词。
items.what_en: A template engine: write text with placeholders and simple logic, then fill in data at runtime to produce web pages, configs or prompts.

items.name: tzdata
items.summary: Provider of IANA time zone data
items.what_zh: 以 Python 包提供 IANA 全球时区数据，让缺少系统时区数据的环境（如 Windows）也能换算时区。
items.what_en: Packages the IANA global time zone database for Python, so time zone conversion works where the system lacks this data, such as Windows.

items.name: protobuf
items.what_zh: Google Protocol Buffers 的 Python 运行库：按预定义结构把数据编成紧凑的二进制格式。
items.what_en: Python runtime for Google's Protocol Buffers: define message structures in advance, then encode data into a compact binary format for transport or storage.

items.name: filelock
items.summary: A platform independent file lock.
items.what_zh: 跨平台的文件锁，确保同一时刻只有一个进程写某个文件，避免多个程序同时写坏数据。
items.what_en: A cross-platform file lock ensuring only one process works on a file at a time, so concurrent programs don't corrupt it.

items.name: scipy
items.summary: Fundamental algorithms for scientific computing in Python
items.what_zh: 建在 NumPy 之上的科学计算算法库，提供优化、积分、插值、统计、信号处理和稀疏矩阵等功能。
items.what_en: Scientific computing algorithms built on NumPy: optimization, integration, interpolation, statistics, signal processing and sparse matrices.

items.name: charset-normalizer
items.summary: The Real First Universal Charset Detector. Open, modern and actively maintained alternative to Chardet.
items.what_zh: 自动识别一段文本用的是哪种字符编码（如 UTF-8、GBK），以便正确解码、避免乱码。
items.what_en: Detects which character encoding a piece of text uses (UTF-8, GBK, etc.) so it can be decoded without garbled characters.

items.name: tslib
items.summary: Runtime library for TypeScript helper functions
items.what_zh: TypeScript 编译后代码所需的辅助函数集合，多个文件共用一份，避免每个文件重复生成。
items.what_en: Runtime helper functions that compiled TypeScript code needs, shared from one package instead of duplicated in every output file.

items.name: python-dotenv
items.summary: Read key-value pairs from a .env file and set them as environment variables
items.what_zh: 从 .env 文件读取键值对并设为环境变量，常用来存放 API 密钥等配置，不必写死在代码里。
items.what_en: Reads key-value pairs from a .env file into environment variables, commonly used for API keys and settings instead of hard-coding them.

items.name: pydantic_core
items.summary: Core functionality for Pydantic validation and serialization
items.what_zh: Pydantic 的核心校验引擎，用 Rust 编写，负责实际的数据校验和序列化计算。
items.what_en: The core validation engine behind Pydantic, written in Rust, doing the actual data validation and serialization work.

items.name: aiohttp
items.summary: Async http client/server framework (asyncio)
items.what_zh: 基于 asyncio 的异步 HTTP 库，既能当客户端同时发出大量请求，也能用来写 Web 服务器。
items.what_en: An async HTTP library built on asyncio, usable both as a client for many simultaneous requests and as a web server.

items.name: tokenizers
items.what_zh: Hugging Face 用 Rust 编写的快速分词器库，把文本切成 token 并转成编号，也能训练新词表。
items.what_en: Hugging Face's fast tokenizer library written in Rust: splits text into tokens, maps them to IDs, and can train new vocabularies.

items.name: fsspec
items.summary: File-system specification
items.what_zh: 统一的文件系统接口：用同一套代码读写本地磁盘、S3 等云存储或 HTTP 地址上的文件。
items.what_en: One file-system interface: the same code reads and writes files on local disk, cloud storage like S3, or HTTP URLs.

items.name: annotated-types
items.summary: Reusable constraint types to use with typing.Annotated
items.what_zh: 提供一组可复用的约束（如大于、最大长度），配合 Annotated 写进类型标注里。
items.what_en: A set of reusable constraints, such as greater-than or max length, that you attach to type hints via typing.Annotated.

items.name: uvicorn
items.summary: The lightning-fast ASGI server.
items.what_zh: 运行 Python 异步 Web 应用的服务器，按 ASGI 标准接口启动 FastAPI 等框架写的程序并接收请求。
items.what_en: A server that runs Python async web apps via the ASGI standard interface, so apps written with FastAPI and similar frameworks can accept requests.

items.name: scheduler
items.summary: Cooperative scheduler for the browser environment.
items.what_zh: React 内部使用的任务调度器，把渲染工作切成小块，在浏览器有空时按优先级执行。
items.what_en: The task scheduler used inside React, breaking rendering work into small chunks run by priority when the browser has time.

items.name: starlette
items.summary: The little ASGI library that shines.
items.what_zh: 轻量的异步 Web 工具包，提供路由、请求响应、WebSocket 等基础能力，FastAPI 就建在它之上。
items.what_en: A lightweight async web toolkit providing routing, requests and responses, and WebSockets; FastAPI is built on top of it.

items.name: @opentelemetry/api
items.summary: Public API for OpenTelemetry
items.what_zh: OpenTelemetry 的公共接口包，让代码用统一方式产生链路追踪、指标等可观测数据。
items.what_en: The public API package of OpenTelemetry, letting code emit tracing, metrics and other observability data in one standard way.

items.name: accelerate
items.summary: Accelerate
items.what_zh: Hugging Face 的训练辅助库：同一份 PyTorch 代码稍作修改，就能在单卡、多卡、多机或混合精度下运行。
items.what_en: A Hugging Face library that lets the same PyTorch code run on one GPU, many GPUs, multiple machines or mixed precision with minimal changes.

items.name: langchain-core
items.summary: Building applications with LLMs through composability
items.what_zh: LangChain 的核心抽象层，定义模型、提示词、工具和链等通用接口，可组合成大模型应用。
items.what_en: The core abstraction layer of LangChain, defining common interfaces for models, prompts, tools and chains that compose into LLM apps.

items.name: einops
items.summary: A new flavour of deep learning operations
items.what_zh: 用可读的表达式（如 "b h w c -> b c h w"）描述张量的维度重排、合并和复制，让代码更易懂。
items.what_en: Describes tensor reshaping with a readable pattern like "b h w c -> b c h w", replacing hard-to-follow chains of reshape and transpose.

items.name: six
items.summary: Python 2 and 3 compatibility utilities
items.what_zh: 让同一份代码同时兼容 Python 2 和 Python 3 的小工具库，如今多见于老项目。
items.what_en: Small helpers letting one codebase run on both Python 2 and Python 3; now mostly found in older projects.

items.name: h11
items.summary: A pure-Python, bring-your-own-I/O implementation of HTTP/1.1
items.what_zh: 纯 Python 实现的 HTTP/1.1 协议库，只负责解析和生成报文，网络收发交给调用方。
items.what_en: A pure-Python HTTP/1.1 protocol library that only parses and builds messages, leaving actual network I/O to the caller.

items.name: Pygments
items.summary: Pygments is a syntax highlighting package written in Python.
items.what_zh: 代码语法高亮库，支持众多编程语言，可输出为 HTML、终端彩色文本等格式。
items.what_en: A syntax highlighter that colors source code in many programming languages, outputting HTML, terminal colors and other formats.

items.name: axios
items.summary: Promise based HTTP client for the browser and node.js
items.what_zh: 基于 Promise 的 HTTP 请求库，浏览器和 Node.js 通用，自动处理 JSON 转换。
items.what_en: A Promise-based HTTP client that works in both browsers and Node.js, converting JSON automatically.

items.name: networkx
items.summary: Python package for creating and manipulating graphs and networks
items.what_zh: 创建和分析“图”（由节点和连线组成的网络）的库，可计算最短路径、中心性、社区划分等。
items.what_en: Creates and analyses graphs, meaning networks of nodes and connections, with algorithms for shortest paths, centrality, communities and more.

items.name: typer
items.summary: Typer, build great CLIs. Easy to code. Based on Python type hints.
items.what_zh: 基于类型标注写命令行工具：函数参数标好类型，就自动变成命令行参数，底层基于 Click。
items.what_en: Build command-line tools from type hints: typed function parameters automatically become CLI arguments. It builds on Click.

items.name: cloudpickle
items.summary: Pickler class to extend the standard pickle.Pickler functionality
items.what_zh: 扩展 Python 的 pickle（把对象转成字节），能打包 lambda、闭包等函数，发到其他进程或机器上运行。
items.what_en: Extends Python's pickle (turning objects into bytes) to handle lambdas, closures and interactively defined functions, so code can run in other processes or machines.

items.name: scikit-learn
items.summary: A set of python modules for machine learning and data mining
items.what_zh: 经典机器学习工具箱，用统一接口提供分类、回归、聚类、降维和模型评估等算法。
items.what_en: A classic machine learning toolkit with one consistent interface for classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction and model evaluation.

items.name: acorn
items.summary: ECMAScript parser

items.name: commander
items.summary: the complete solution for node.js command-line programs
items.what_zh: Node.js 上编写命令行程序的工具，负责解析参数和选项、组织子命令并自动生成帮助信息。
items.what_en: A toolkit for Node.js command-line programs: parses arguments and options, organizes subcommands and generates help text.

items.name: @types/unist
items.summary: TypeScript definitions for unist
items.what_zh: unist（一种通用语法树格式）的 TypeScript 类型定义，让处理 Markdown 语法树的代码有类型提示。
items.what_en: TypeScript type definitions for unist, a shared syntax-tree format, giving type hints to code that processes Markdown or HTML trees.

items.name: attrs
items.summary: Classes Without Boilerplate
items.what_zh: 只需声明字段，就自动生成类的构造函数、比较和打印等样板代码的 Python 库。
items.what_en: A Python library that generates class boilerplate, such as constructors, comparisons and readable printing, from a short field declaration.

items.name: markdown-it-py
items.summary: Python port of markdown-it. Markdown parsing, done right!
items.what_zh: 按 CommonMark 规范把 Markdown 解析成语法结构或 HTML，移植自 markdown-it。
items.what_en: Parses Markdown text into a structure or HTML; ported from JavaScript's markdown-it and following the CommonMark standard.

items.name: triton
items.summary: A language and compiler for custom Deep Learning operations
items.what_zh: OpenAI 开源的 GPU 编程语言和编译器，用类似 Python 的语法编写高性能深度学习算子。
items.what_en: An open-source GPU programming language and compiler from OpenAI for writing fast deep learning operations in Python-like syntax.

items.name: tensorflow
items.summary: TensorFlow is an open source machine learning framework for everyone.
items.what_zh: Google 开源的深度学习框架，用于构建、训练和部署神经网络，可运行在服务器、手机、浏览器等环境。
items.what_en: Google's open-source deep learning framework for building, training and deploying neural networks across servers, mobile devices and browsers.

items.name: hono
items.summary: Web framework built on Web Standards
items.what_zh: 基于 Web 标准的轻量 Web 框架，同一份代码可跑在 Cloudflare Workers、Node.js 等环境。
items.what_en: A lightweight web framework built on Web Standard APIs; the same code runs on Cloudflare Workers, Node.js, Bun and more.

items.name: matplotlib
items.summary: Python plotting package
items.what_zh: Python 最常用的绘图库，可画折线图、柱状图、散点图等，导出为图片或直接显示在 Notebook 里。
items.what_en: Python's most widely used plotting library: line, bar, scatter and many other charts, exported as images or shown in notebooks.

items.name: mdurl
items.summary: Markdown URL utilities
items.what_zh: 处理 Markdown 中网址的小工具，负责链接的编码、解码和解析，主要供 markdown-it-py 使用。
items.what_en: Small utilities for URLs in Markdown, encoding, decoding and parsing links; used mainly by markdown-it-py.

items.name: clsx
items.summary: A tiny (239B) utility for constructing className strings conditionally.
items.what_zh: 按条件拼接 CSS 类名字符串的小工具，常用于 React 组件里根据状态切换样式。
items.what_en: A tiny utility that builds CSS class-name strings conditionally, often used in React components to switch styles by state.

items.name: python-multipart
items.summary: A streaming multipart parser for Python
items.what_zh: 解析网页表单和文件上传数据（multipart 格式）的 Python 库，可边接收边处理。
items.what_en: A Python library that parses form submissions and file uploads (the multipart format), processing data as it streams in.

items.name: lxml
items.summary: Powerful and Pythonic XML processing library combining libxml2/libxslt with the ElementTree API.
items.what_zh: 基于 C 库 libxml2 的 XML/HTML 解析库，支持 XPath（按路径定位元素）查询，接口与标准库一致。
items.what_en: An XML and HTML parsing library built on the C library libxml2, supporting XPath queries (locating elements by path) with an ElementTree-style API.

items.name: beautifulsoup4
items.summary: Screen-scraping library
items.what_zh: 从 HTML、XML 网页中提取数据的库，能容忍不规范的网页代码，按标签和属性方便地查找内容。
items.what_en: Extracts data from HTML and XML pages, tolerating messy markup and letting you find content by tags and attributes.

items.name: wcwidth
items.summary: Measures the displayed width of unicode strings in a terminal
items.what_zh: 计算字符串在终端里实际占几列宽的 Python 库，中文、emoji 等宽字符也能算对。
items.what_en: A Python library that measures how many columns a string occupies in a terminal, correctly handling wide characters like Chinese and emoji.

items.name: ajv
items.summary: Another JSON Schema Validator
items.what_zh: 按 JSON Schema 规则检查 JSON 数据是否合格的 JavaScript 校验库，会把规则编译成函数来加速。
items.what_en: A JavaScript validator that checks JSON data against JSON Schema rules, compiling schemas into functions for fast validation.

items.name: tenacity
items.summary: Retry code until it succeeds
items.what_zh: 给函数加上自动重试的 Python 库，可设置重试次数、等待间隔和触发条件。
items.what_en: A Python library that adds automatic retries to functions, with configurable attempts, wait intervals and retry conditions.

items.name: websockets
items.summary: An implementation of the WebSocket Protocol (RFC 6455 & 7692)
items.what_zh: 实现 WebSocket 协议的 Python 库，基于 asyncio，用于建立客户端与服务端的双向实时连接。
items.what_en: A Python implementation of the WebSocket protocol, built on asyncio, for two-way real-time client-server connections.

items.name: pydantic-settings
items.summary: Settings management using Pydantic
items.what_zh: 用 Pydantic 模型定义和校验配置的 Python 库，从环境变量、.env 文件读取并自动转换类型。
items.what_en: A Python library that defines and validates settings as Pydantic models, reading environment variables and .env files with automatic type conversion.

items.name: pycparser
items.summary: C parser in Python
items.what_zh: 用纯 Python 写的 C 语言解析器，把 C 代码解析成语法树；cffi 用它读懂 C 函数声明。
items.what_en: A C-language parser written in pure Python that turns C code into a syntax tree; cffi uses it to read C function declarations.

items.name: node-addon-api
items.summary: Node.js API (Node-API)
items.what_zh: 用 C++ 编写 Node.js 原生扩展的头文件封装，基于稳定的 Node-API，升级 Node 后无需重新编译。
items.what_en: C++ header wrappers for writing native Node.js addons on the stable Node-API, so addons need not be rebuilt for each Node version.

items.name: type-fest
items.summary: A collection of essential TypeScript types

items.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
items.summary: Model Context Protocol implementation for TypeScript
items.what_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）的官方 TypeScript SDK：写 MCP 服务器或客户端，把工具和数据接入大模型应用。
items.what_en: The official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP): write MCP servers or clients that connect tools and data to LLM apps.

items.name: vue
items.summary: The progressive JavaScript framework for building modern web UI.
items.what_zh: 构建网页界面的渐进式 JavaScript 框架，数据变化时页面自动更新，可从小组件逐步扩展到完整应用。
items.what_en: A progressive JavaScript framework for building web interfaces: the page updates when data changes, scaling from small widgets to full apps.

items.name: tabulate
items.summary: Pretty-print tabular data
items.what_zh: 把列表或表格数据打印成整齐文本表格的 Python 库，支持 Markdown、HTML 等输出格式。
items.what_en: A Python library that prints lists or tabular data as neatly aligned text tables, including Markdown and HTML formats.

items.name: dotenv
items.summary: Loads environment variables from .env file
items.what_zh: 启动时把 .env 文件里的配置读进环境变量的 Node.js 库，常用来存放 API Key。
items.what_en: A Node.js library that loads settings from a .env file into environment variables at startup, often used for API keys.

items.name: @ai-sdk/provider
items.what_zh: Vercel AI SDK 的模型提供方接口规范，规定各家大模型接入时要实现的统一类型和方法。
items.what_en: The provider specification for the Vercel AI SDK: the shared types and methods each LLM provider integration must implement.

items.name: joblib
items.summary: Lightweight pipelining with Python functions
items.what_zh: 让 Python 函数轻松并行运行、把结果缓存到磁盘，并高效保存含大数组对象的工具库。
items.what_en: A Python toolkit for running functions in parallel, caching results to disk, and efficiently saving objects holding large arrays.

items.name: pyarrow
items.summary: Python library for Apache Arrow
items.what_zh: Apache Arrow 的 Python 库，用列式内存格式高效处理大表格数据，并能读写 Parquet 等文件。
items.what_en: The Python library for Apache Arrow, a columnar in-memory format for handling large tables, plus reading and writing files such as Parquet.

items.name: sniffio
items.summary: Sniff out which async library your code is running under
items.what_zh: 检测当前代码运行在哪个异步库（asyncio 或 Trio）之下的小工具，方便库作者同时兼容两者。
items.what_en: A tiny tool that detects which async library (asyncio or Trio) the current code is running under, helping libraries support both.

items.name: nltk
items.summary: Natural Language Toolkit
items.what_zh: 经典的 Python 自然语言处理工具包，提供分词、词性标注、词干提取和语料库等功能。
items.what_en: A classic Python natural language processing toolkit offering tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, stemming and bundled corpora.

items.name: defusedxml
items.summary: XML bomb protection for Python stdlib modules
items.what_zh: 安全版 XML 解析工具，防止恶意构造的 XML（如“XML 炸弹”）耗尽内存或读取本地文件。
items.what_en: Safer XML parsing that blocks malicious XML, such as 'XML bombs' that exhaust memory or tricks that read local files.

items.name: orjson
items.summary: Fast, correct Python JSON library supporting dataclasses, datetimes, and numpy
items.what_zh: 速度很快的 Python JSON 读写库，能直接处理 dataclass、日期时间和 numpy 数组。
items.what_en: A fast Python JSON library that directly handles dataclasses, datetimes and numpy arrays.

items.name: json-schema
items.summary: JSON Schema validation and specifications
items.what_zh: 早期 JSON Schema 包，含规范草案和简易校验；JSON Schema 用于描述 JSON 数据结构。
items.what_en: An early JSON Schema package with specification draft files and a simple validator; JSON Schema describes what JSON data should look like.

items.name: debug
items.summary: Lightweight debugging utility for Node.js and the browser
items.what_zh: 按模块名开关调试日志的小工具，用环境变量 DEBUG 控制显示哪些模块的输出。
items.what_en: A tiny debugging utility that turns log output on per module name, controlled by the DEBUG environment variable.

items.name: cryptography
items.summary: cryptography is a package which provides cryptographic recipes and primitives to Python developers.
items.what_zh: 为 Python 提供加密、解密、签名和证书处理的密码学库，既有易用接口也有底层算法。
items.what_en: A library giving Python encryption, decryption, signing and certificate handling, with both easy high-level recipes and low-level primitives.

items.name: httpcore
items.summary: A minimal low-level HTTP client.
items.what_zh: 精简的底层 HTTP 客户端，负责连接池和收发请求，httpx 就建在它之上。
items.what_en: A minimal low-level HTTP client handling connection pooling and sending requests; httpx is built on top of it.

items.name: ml-dtypes
items.summary: ml_dtypes is a stand-alone implementation of several NumPy dtype extensions used in machine learning.
items.what_zh: 给 NumPy 补上机器学习常用的数值类型，如 bfloat16 和多种 8 位浮点数，用于低精度计算。
items.what_en: Adds machine-learning number formats missing from NumPy, such as bfloat16 and several 8-bit floats, used for lower-precision computing.

items.name: uuid
items.summary: RFC9562 UUIDs
items.what_zh: 生成 UUID（几乎不会重复的唯一标识符）的库，常用来给订单、消息、文件分配 ID。
items.what_en: Generates UUIDs, practically unique identifiers, commonly used as non-colliding IDs for orders, messages or files.

items.name: opencv-python
items.summary: Wrapper package for OpenCV python bindings.
items.what_zh: OpenCV 计算机视觉库的 Python 预编译包，用于读写图片视频、缩放裁剪、滤波和特征检测等。
items.what_en: Prebuilt Python packages of OpenCV, the computer vision library, for reading images and video, resizing, filtering, feature detection and more.

items.name: loguru
items.summary: Python logging made (stupidly) simple
items.what_zh: 无需配置的 Python 日志库，导入即可输出带颜色、时间和代码位置的日志，并支持日志文件轮转。
items.what_en: A Python logging library that works with no setup: import it to get colored logs with timestamps and source locations, plus file rotation.

items.name: dill
items.summary: serialize all of Python
items.what_zh: 扩展版的 pickle，能把 lambda、嵌套函数、类等几乎任何 Python 对象存成字节，再原样还原。
items.what_en: An extended pickle that can save almost any Python object, including lambdas, nested functions and classes, to bytes and restore it.

items.name: SQLAlchemy
items.summary: Database Abstraction Library
items.what_zh: 用同一套 Python 代码操作 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 等数据库的工具包，还能把表映射成类。
items.what_en: A Python database toolkit for working with MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and others through one API, including an ORM that maps tables to classes.

items.name: docker
items.summary: A Python library for the Docker Engine API.
items.what_zh: 用 Python 代码操作 Docker：拉取镜像、启停容器、查看日志，背后调用 Docker Engine API。
items.what_en: Lets Python code control Docker, such as pulling images, starting and stopping containers and reading logs, via the Docker Engine API.

items.name: sympy
items.summary: Computer algebra system (CAS) in Python
items.what_zh: Python 的符号计算库，能化简公式、求导、积分和解方程，得到精确表达式而不只是数值。
items.what_en: A Python library for symbolic math: simplifying formulas, differentiating, integrating and solving equations exactly, not just numerically.

items.name: xxhash
items.summary: Python binding for xxHash
items.what_zh: xxHash 算法的 Python 绑定，可快速为数据计算哈希指纹，适合去重和缓存键，但不能用于加密。
items.what_en: Python bindings for xxHash, a very fast non-cryptographic hash for fingerprinting data, suited to deduplication and cache keys, not security.

items.name: referencing
items.summary: JSON Referencing + Python
items.what_zh: 解析 JSON 文档中 $ref 引用的 Python 库，jsonschema 用它查找被引用的子 Schema。
items.what_en: A Python library that resolves $ref references inside JSON documents; jsonschema uses it to find referenced sub-schemas.

items.name: marked
items.summary: A markdown parser built for speed
items.what_zh: 把 Markdown 文本快速转换成 HTML 的 JavaScript 解析器。
items.what_en: A fast JavaScript parser that converts Markdown text into HTML.

items.name: Flask
items.summary: A simple framework for building complex web applications.
items.what_zh: 轻量的 Python Web 框架，几行代码就能写出网页或 API 服务，其余功能按需加扩展。
items.what_en: A lightweight Python web framework: a few lines give you a web page or API service, with extensions added as needed.

items.name: llama-index-core
items.summary: Interface between LLMs and your data
items.what_zh: LlamaIndex 的核心包，用来把文档等自有数据接入大模型，搭建 RAG 问答和智能体应用。
items.what_en: The core package of LlamaIndex, for connecting your own data, like documents, to LLMs to build RAG question-answering and agent apps.

items.name: next
items.summary: The React Framework
items.what_zh: 基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架，内置路由、服务端渲染和 API 接口，便于构建完整网站。
items.what_en: A full-stack web framework built on React, with built-in routing, server-side rendering and API routes for complete websites.

items.name: @babel/runtime
items.summary: babel's modular runtime helpers
items.what_zh: Babel 转译后代码要用的公共辅助函数集合，让各文件共用一份，而不是每个文件各复制一份。
items.what_en: Shared helper functions used by Babel-compiled code, so files import one copy instead of each embedding its own.

items.name: flatbuffers
items.summary: The FlatBuffers serialization format for Python
items.what_zh: Google 二进制序列化格式 FlatBuffers 的 Python 实现，读数据无需先完整解析，省时省内存。
items.what_en: Python support for FlatBuffers, Google's binary serialization format whose data can be read without unpacking it first, saving time and memory.

items.name: ms
items.summary: Tiny millisecond conversion utility
items.what_zh: 在毫秒数与“2 days”“1h”这类可读时间写法之间互相转换的小工具。
items.what_en: A tiny utility converting between milliseconds and readable time strings like "2 days" or "1h".

items.name: chalk
items.summary: Terminal string styling done right
items.what_zh: 给终端输出的文字加颜色和样式（加粗、下划线等）的 Node.js 库。
items.what_en: A Node.js library that adds colors and styles like bold or underline to terminal text.

items.name: langgraph
items.summary: Building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs
items.what_zh: 用图（节点和连线）编排有状态、多步骤的大模型应用和多智能体流程的框架。
items.what_en: A framework for orchestrating stateful, multi-step LLM apps and multi-agent workflows as graphs of nodes and edges.

items.name: omegaconf
items.summary: A flexible configuration library
items.what_zh: 层级化的 Python 配置库，可合并多个 YAML 文件和命令行参数，并支持变量引用。
items.what_en: A Python library for hierarchical configuration, merging YAML files and command-line overrides, with variable interpolation.

items.name: mpmath
items.summary: Python library for arbitrary-precision floating-point arithmetic
items.what_zh: 做任意精度浮点运算的 Python 数学库，可自定义小数位数，突破普通 float 的精度限制。
items.what_en: A Python math library for arbitrary-precision floating-point arithmetic, letting you choose how many digits to compute beyond a normal float.

items.name: express
items.summary: Fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework
items.what_zh: Node.js 上的经典 Web 框架，用路由和中间件搭建网站和 API 服务，风格简洁、不强加结构。
items.what_en: A classic minimalist web framework for Node.js, building websites and APIs from routes and middleware without imposing structure.

items.name: @opentelemetry/semantic-conventions
items.summary: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions

items.name: semver
items.summary: The semantic version parser used by npm.
items.what_zh: 解析和比较语义化版本号（如 1.2.3）的库，npm 自己就用它判断版本范围。

items.name: rpds-py

items.name: grpcio
